verification.method: Fetched the two authoritative City PDFs, recomputed length and SHA-256, extracted text and metadata, and visually rendered every page. Both current files exactly matched saved 2026-09-14 bytes and checksums. No source replacement was found at either authoritative URL.

records.title: APD Resource Card
records.issuing_body: City of Albuquerque, Albuquerque Police Department
records.date_and_edition: Updated February 1, 2026; file revision 2; PDF created February 24, 2026
records.intended_audience: APD officers making referrals and people receiving the folded card
records.format: Two 17.58 x 6.08 inch print-artwork sides forming a ten-panel folded card

quality_assessment.visual_document_quality: Legible but tightly typeset multi-panel print artwork, designed for folding rather than screen reading.
quality_assessment.information_density: High for a referral card: shelters, health, crisis, housing, family, legal, and employment contacts.
quality_assessment.standalone_public_value: Limited. Its value is immediate operational referral; provider details, hours, eligibility, phone numbers, and programs require continual maintenance.
quality_assessment.intended_publication_form: Current operational handout, not enduring historical guide.
quality_assessment.rationale: It does not meet the durable-publication test despite authoritative provenance and dense content.

records.newer_or_stronger_canonical_version: No newer PDF was found at the authoritative URL. The absence of a replacement does not convert a volatile referral card into a durable record.

records.title: ABQ Area Resources Quick Guide
records.issuing_body: City of Albuquerque Health, Housing & Homelessness
records.intended_audience: Albuquerque-area residents and navigators seeking current social-service referrals
records.format: Letter-size, tagged Microsoft Word PDF with 316 embedded links

quality_assessment.visual_document_quality: Legible, well-structured two-column directory with clear category headings; utilitarian rather than archival editorial design.
quality_assessment.information_density: High: current services, contact details, eligibility cues, referral procedures, and web links.
quality_assessment.standalone_public_value: Limited as a durable record because its contact directory must stay current. Its own opening page identifies the CABQ HHH Connect to Resources page as the maintained access context.
quality_assessment.intended_publication_form: Maintained live-service directory, not enduring historical guide.
quality_assessment.rationale: The document is useful now but has no meaningful durable ABQInfo home or independent historical/public-information value that outweighs rapid obsolescence.

records.newer_or_stronger_canonical_version: No newer PDF was found at the authoritative URL. The maintained City resource-service context is stronger for access than a static archival placement.

family_relationship: The records overlap substantially in shelters, crisis, health, housing, and other referrals, but they are genuinely independent current guides: the APD card is a compact officer-facing referral handout and the Quick Guide is a much broader resident-facing directory. Their different formats, audiences, scope, text, dates, and checksums establish that neither is duplicate, superseded, nor canonical for the other.
placement_decision: No canonical ABQInfo page is proposed. The saved research suggestion to cross-list either item under About was rejected because generic City authorship is not a meaningful durable information architecture.
safeguards: No pull request, merge, or deployment
